UnitStatement: DEL-08-01 DeliverableID is DEL-08-01; DeliverableName is Instruction Root Packaging and Agent Conformance.
DEL-08-01 belongs to PackageID PKG-08 (Agent Suite, Pipeline Dispatch, and Subagent Governance).
DEL-08-01 uses DecompositionVariant SOFTWARE_DECOMP at DecompositionRevision v3.2.
DEL-08-01 deliverable Type is TEST_SUITE; ResponsibleParty is TBD.
DEL-08-01 covers scope items SOW-030, SOW-031, SOW-073 and supports objectives OBJ-007, OBJ-008.
DEL-08-01 purpose is to verify required instruction-root assets, agent metadata, write scopes, naming, and section markers.
Anticipated DEL-08-01 artifacts are an agent conformance validator, integrity fixtures, and a source-completeness checklist.
The instruction root is a release-managed resource set containing governance documents, agent instructions, and framework materials.
The instruction root is read-only during ordinary project execution; writes must be blocked by runtime hooks and path policy.

Required source-tree/packaged-app entries include AGENTS.md, README.md, agents/, docs/, docs/DIRECTIVE.md, docs/CONTRACT.md, docs/SPEC.md, docs/TYPES.md, docs/PLAN.md, plus WHAT-IS-AN-AGENT.md and PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md where required.
PRD packaging acceptance entries (PRD FR-058) include agents/, docs/, AGENTS.md, README.md, WHAT-IS-AN-AGENT.md, and PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md where required by integrity policy.
Agent instruction files use AGENT_*.md filenames.
The required instruction header contains [[DOC:AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS]], a title, and AGENT_TYPE: {0|1|2}.
The required Agent Type table fields are AGENT_TYPE, AGENT_CLASS, INTERACTION_SURFACE, WRITE_SCOPE, BLOCKING, and PRIMARY_OUTPUTS.
Required section markers are [[BEGIN:PROTOCOL]], [[BEGIN:SPEC]], [[BEGIN:STRUCTURE]], [[BEGIN:RATIONALE]] with matching end markers.
A Type 2 candidate is an agent instruction with AGENT_TYPE: 2; preferred AGENT_CLASS is TASK.
Type 2 task-agent execution requires sealed context and gate approval metadata (CONTRACT K-SEAL-1).
Every agent instruction file must declare explicit write scope; agents must not write outside declared scope (CONTRACT K-WRITE-1).
DEL-08-01 is a test-suite work item for PKG-08 and must not expand runtime capability.
The test suite must respect instruction-root/working-root separation; ordinary execution may write project truth only under the working root.
docs/PRD.md is locally accessible but recorded as HASH_MISMATCH in _REFERENCES.md; treat PRD-derived items as source-warning context until reconciled.

Declared upstream/downstream lists remain TBD; the register records PKG-08/SOW/OBJ anchors and upstream prerequisites REF-001..REF-007 and DEC-004, with no downstream edges because extraction ran with CONSUMER_CONTEXT=NONE.
ASSUMPTION: validator target path, test framework, and exact fixture directory are later coding-task choices and are TBD here.
The agent conformance validator checks instruction files for naming, required header, agent type declaration/table fields, required markers, and declared write scope.
Integrity fixtures provide positive and negative fixtures for complete and incomplete instruction-root asset sets.
The source-completeness checklist covers required root assets and source-completeness risks.
Governance fixture cases cover Type 2 candidate, non-Type-2 candidate, missing metadata, missing markers, invalid write scope, and attempted instruction-root write.
Implementation location, command name, and CI wiring for the construction package are TBD.
DEL-08-01 references docs/DIRECTIVE.md sections 2.7 and 5.
DEL-08-01 cites agents/AGENT_SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md header and agent type table as a local conformance example.

DEL-08-01 exists to make instruction-root packaging and agent conformance explicit and repeatable, supporting OBJ-007 (agent-suite integrity, governed delegation without expanding authority) and OBJ-008 (repeatable validation).
Treat the instruction root as release-managed; the working root is mutable project truth, the instruction root is not ordinary task output.
Validate conformance from source files and registries, not from narrative counts.
Keep the validator conservative: missing source evidence becomes TBD, warning, or failure per the governing source and must not be silently accepted (CONTRACT K-INVENT-1, K-CONFLICT-1).
Separate conformance validation from runtime capability implementation; DEL-08-01 verifies packaging/conformance while DEL-08-04 and DEL-08-05 cover subagent bridge execution and child records.
Preserve source authority labels: SPEC-backed requirements are current governing structure, while PRD-backed requirements carry the HASH_MISMATCH warning until reconciled.
For required assets, use docs/SPEC.md section 1.1 as the primary required-entry list and add PRD FR-058/KG-001 candidates as warning-labeled completeness checks.
For agent metadata, validate both the compact header and the Agent Type table; each required row has a separate failure mode.
Section-marker checks should validate paired begin/end markers and section identity, not merely text presence.
For Type 2 candidates, AGENT_TYPE: 2 is required and AGENT_CLASS: TASK is preferred; treat non-Type-2 delegation candidates as denial cases.
Validate declared WRITE_SCOPE values against vocabulary and fixture expected behavior; runtime enforcement remains a separate hook/path-policy concern.
For unknown option keys, warnings are preferable to behavior mutation.
Trade-off: warn rather than fail on PRD-only items until the PRD hash mismatch is reconciled, because the brief treats docs/PRD.md HASH_MISMATCH as a source warning.
Trade-off: use structured parsing where feasible and allow simple text fixtures only for early validator scaffolding, since marker/metadata checks have stable SPEC schemas.
Trade-off: check instruction-root assets and conformance only and leave DMG packaging to DEL-09-04.
Trade-off: include fail-closed fixture expectations but do not implement the runtime subagent bridge here, since DEL-08-04 owns the evaluateSubagentGovernance bridge.

PRD-only checks remain warning-labeled while REF-006 is HASH_MISMATCH; until a human or reconciliation refreshes _REFERENCES.md or amends the source basis, SPEC/CONTRACT/TYPES remain governing authority and PRD-only entries are checklist warnings (REF-006; K-CONFLICT-1).
Positive expectation: agent-instruction filename matches AGENT_*.md.
Positive expectation: header includes [[DOC:AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS]].
Positive expectation: header declares AGENT_TYPE.
Positive expectation: Agent Type table includes all required rows from SPEC section 7.2.
Positive expectation: required marker pairs are present for PROTOCOL, SPEC, STRUCTURE, and RATIONALE when the contract requires those sections.
Negative fixture: missing AGENTS.md in an instruction-root fixture is a packaging-readiness failure under SPEC section 1.1.
Negative fixture: missing WRITE_SCOPE in an agent instruction is a conformance failure under SPEC section 7.2 and CONTRACT K-WRITE-1.
Negative fixture: a Type 2 subagent request without sealed context or approval metadata is denied under CONTRACT K-SEAL-1 and K-SUBAGENT-1.
Negative fixture: a PRD KG-001-only asset such as tools/REGISTRY.md is surfaced as a source-completeness warning while docs/PRD.md remains hash-mismatched.

Conflict CT-001: docs/PRD.md is accessible but its hash does not match _REFERENCES.md REF-006, so PRD-only requirements may be stale; proposed authority is SPEC/CONTRACT/TYPES with PRD-only items as warning-labeled checks until REF-006 is reconciled (human ruling TBD).
The procedure defines operations to produce and verify DEL-08-01 test-suite artifacts: agent conformance validator, integrity fixtures, and source-completeness checklist.
Prerequisite: accepted deliverable context in _CONTEXT.md.
Prerequisite: accessible authoritative references from _REFERENCES.md.
Prerequisite: decomposition reference execution/_Decomposition/Chirality_App_vNext_SOFTWARE_DECOMP_v3_2.md.
Prerequisite: current instruction-root source tree containing candidate root assets and agents/AGENT_*.md files.
Prerequisite: test framework, validator command, and fixture directory are TBD.
Prerequisite: upstream/downstream lists are TBD; the register records only upstream source prerequisites with no downstream edges, and deliverable edges must not be invented from boundary references.
Step 1: establish the accepted source basis by reading _REFERENCES.md, recording matching sources and source warnings, and marking docs/PRD.md as HASH_MISMATCH warning context until reconciled.

Step 2: build the instruction-root asset manifest starting from SPEC section 1.1 required entries, adding PRD FR-058/KG-001 entries as warning-labeled candidates (REF-006 hash-mismatched), and recording each asset as present, missing, not-required, or TBD.

Step 3: define agent-instruction conformance checks for filename AGENT_*.md, required header ([[DOC:AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS]], title, AGENT_TYPE), Agent Type table rows, required section-marker pairs (PROTOCOL/SPEC/STRUCTURE/RATIONALE when applicable), and warn on unknown runtime metadata option keys.

Step 4: define Type 2 and subagent governance fixture checks: identify Type 2 by AGENT_TYPE: 2, prefer AGENT_CLASS: TASK, deny non-Type-2 or non-allowlisted delegation, and deny subagent requests lacking sealed context, approved pipeline state, approval reference, and restricted child tool/cwd config.

Step 5: implement or update validator and fixtures, recording validator path, fixture path, test framework, CI/local command, and pass/fail artifact directory (all TBD) before treating verification as executable, and keep outputs under the working root without writing to the instruction root.

Step 6: run verification by executing the local validator/test command, confirming positive fixtures pass and negative fixtures fail with actionable messages, confirming PRD-only checks are warning-labeled, and capturing pass/fail evidence (command, tree/commit id, fixture summary, warning/failure counts, artifact location).

Step 7: record results by storing validator output, source-completeness checklist, and fixture summary in the test artifact location (TBD), and recording unresolved source warnings and human-ruling needs.

DEL-08-01 specifies test-suite expectations for verifying instruction-root packaging and agent instruction conformance in PKG-08.
In scope: required instruction-root asset presence and packaging integrity checks.
In scope: agent instruction filename, header, metadata, write-scope, and section-marker conformance.
In scope: source-completeness checklist coverage for instruction-root assets.
In scope: fixture coverage for valid and invalid instruction-root and agent-instruction cases.
Out of scope: general SDK adapter mechanics.
Out of scope: runtime capability expansion.
Out of scope: implementation of the subagent governance bridge, which belongs to DEL-08-04.
Out of scope: parent-child subagent run records, which belong to DEL-08-05.
DEL0801-REQ001: the test suite MUST verify the instruction root is treated as release-managed and read-only during ordinary project execution (SPEC 1.1; CONTRACT K-ROOT-2).
DEL0801-REQ002: the test suite MUST verify the working root is separate from the instruction root and is the ordinary project-truth write location (DIRECTIVE 2.7; CONTRACT K-ROOT-1/K-ROOT-3).
DEL0801-REQ003: the test suite MUST check the required instruction-root entries listed by SPEC section 1.1.
DEL0801-REQ004: the test suite SHOULD include PRD FR-058 packaging acceptance entries, but PRD-derived expectations MUST be reported with the current HASH_MISMATCH source warning until reconciled.
DEL0801-REQ005: the source-completeness checklist MUST surface SOW-073/OI-004 required instruction-root asset incompleteness as a packaging-readiness issue.
DEL0801-REQ006: agent instruction files MUST be named with the AGENT_*.md convention (SPEC section 7).
DEL0801-REQ007: agent instruction files MUST include the required instruction header and AGENT_TYPE declaration (SPEC section 7.1).
DEL0801-REQ008: agent instruction files MUST include an Agent Type table with AGENT_TYPE, AGENT_CLASS, INTERACTION_SURFACE, WRITE_SCOPE, BLOCKING, and PRIMARY_OUTPUTS (SPEC section 7.2).
DEL0801-REQ009: agent instruction conformance MUST validate required section markers for PROTOCOL, SPEC, STRUCTURE, and RATIONALE where the contract requires those sections (SPEC section 7.3).
DEL0801-REQ010: agent conformance MUST verify explicit write-scope declaration and preserve the invariant that agents do not write outside declared scope (CONTRACT K-WRITE-1; TYPES AGENT properties).
DEL0801-REQ011: Type 2 candidate checks MUST identify AGENT_TYPE: 2 and prefer AGENT_CLASS: TASK (TYPES Type 2 vocabulary).

DEL0801-REQ012: subagent-related conformance MUST fail closed when required governance metadata is absent and MUST NOT grant child agents expanded capabilities (CONTRACT K-SEAL-1, K-GHOST-1, K-SUBAGENT-1/2; PRD FR-060 hash warning).
DEL0801-REQ013: the validator MUST treat registry surfaces as source registries rather than relying on mutable count prose (PRD KG-013 hash warning).
DEL0801-REQ014: unknown runtime metadata option keys MUST be ignored with warnings rather than silently mutating behavior (SPEC section 7.4).
Standard: the Chirality instruction root model defines required assets, read-only policy, and root separation (SPEC section 1; DIRECTIVE section 2.7).
Standard: the Chirality agent instruction contract defines required filenames, headers, metadata table, and section markers (SPEC section 7).
Standard: the Chirality invariant contract defines K-ROOT, K-PACKAGE, K-WRITE, K-SEAL, K-GHOST, and K-SUBAGENT checks (CONTRACT sections 1.3 and 1.8).
Standard: the Chirality vocabulary defines Type 2 candidates, task agents, write-scope vocabulary, and pipeline/task scope terms (TYPES sections 3.2, 4.4, Type 2 vocabulary).
Standard: PRD acceptance requirements provide FR-058 through FR-063 and known source-completeness gaps, with the current hash warning (PRD sections 8.10 and 15).
Verification approach: static source-tree checks for required instruction-root entries.
Verification approach: static agent-instruction parsing checks for filename, header, required metadata, and marker pairs.
Verification approach: fixture-driven positive and negative cases for missing assets and malformed agent files.
Verification approach: path-policy/hook-level tests for instruction-root write denial where runtime enforcement is available.
Verification approach: checklist output that separates SPEC-backed requirements from PRD-backed source-warning items.

Verification matrix: DEL0801-REQ003, REQ004, REQ005 are verified by the instruction-root integrity fixture and source-completeness checklist.
Verification matrix: DEL0801-REQ006 through REQ010 and REQ014 are verified by the agent conformance validator fixture suite.
